experiment: RIM-ONE DL official hospital partition glaucoma versus normal

internal_validation.method: stratified image-level split within official training hospitals

candidates: frozen ConvNeXt-Tiny ImageNet1K_V1 features with logistic regression C=0.1 and class_weight=balanced
fine-tuned ConvNeXt-Tiny ImageNet1K_V1; AdamW backbone_lr=1e-5 head_lr=3e-4 weight_decay=0.02; early stop after four stale validation AUROC epochs
selection: Validation AUROC then average precision; threshold maximizing specificity subject to validation sensitivity >=0.90; if infeasible use validation maximum-sensitivity point and report infeasibility.
test: One pass on official held-out hospital partition after candidate and threshold freeze.
terms: Research/education use only; redistribution prohibited per source repository. Dataset, row-level manifests, predictions and checkpoint remain private.
limitations: No patient identifiers in release; patient-level disjointness is unverified.
Hospital-held-out benchmark is not independent prospective clinical validation.
Single small source cohort; performance is not generalized glaucoma diagnosis.
